description: This file defines a set of Data Transfer Objects (DTOs) related to shopping cart operations in a grocery backend application. It includes classes for cart responses, cart item responses, and requests to add or update cart items.

classes.name: CartItemResponse
classes.description: A DTO representing individual items within a cart, including item ID, product details, and quantity.

classes.name: CartResponse
classes.description: A DTO representing the overall cart, including its ID, list of items, and last updated timestamp.

classes.name: AddToCartRequest
classes.description: A request DTO for adding a new item to the cart, including product ID and quantity with validation annotations.

classes.name: UpdateCartItemRequest
classes.description: A request DTO for updating the quantity of a cart item, with validation annotations.
